---
id: env.pay.recoveries
type: payment
heading: Recoveries
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

We may take over and conduct, in your name, any right of recovery you have for a loss we pay, including against a person responsible for the pollution condition. Any amount recovered, after the reasonable costs of the recovery, is applied first to us up to what we paid, and then to you, including for the excess. You must not give up any right of recovery after a pollution condition begins without our written consent.
